mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) above a 3% YoY growth rate signals strong consumer demand, which is typically associated with positive economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances during a monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in the same month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decrease > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST YoY > 10% and RSAFS YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY signals a contraction in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY < -1% during a late-cycle expansion.
